arithmetic.coordinates: finite decimal strings -> Decimal -> Fraction; no float intermediate
arithmetic.directions: clear each row denominator, then divide by the integer gcd
arithmetic.normalization: v_i / sqrt(q_i), q_i = v_i dot v_i > 0
arithmetic.strict_pair_test: p <= 0, or 4*p^2 < q_i*q_j for p > 0 when strict=true
